Method of Attack: Delivered via spam email with MHT (MHTML) file attachments
MHT file downloads an HTA file
HTA file downloads a Visual Basic script
Visual Basic script downloads the Fareit malware
Acts as an infostealer and malware downloader
Attack Vector: Spam email with MHT file attachment
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by use of HTA and Visual Basic script)
Indicators of Compromise: Spam email posing as HSBC payment request with MHT document attachment
